name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Tankers hit in Hormuz on 5 Nov; Tehran contacts Gulf states amid fears of US strikes
state: Tankers were hit in Hormuz on 5 Nov as Iran kept up pressure after the US midterms (US News). Tehran contacted Oman, Qatar and Saudi Arabia amid fears of renewed US strikes, after Trump warned of a 'heavy hit' (Al Jazeera; Gulf News). Qatari mediators are pushing a draft deal; Iran demands an end to the US blockade and sanctions relief.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states, which can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Attacks on Gulf shipping and Hormuz substantially closed = Alert

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
